title: Every theme has a kit for every profile: general, creators, schools, clubs, faith, wellness and markets, on all seven themes
detail: 49 kits (7 themes x 7 profile niches), id <prefix>-<niche>, listed in PROFILE_KIT_INDEX and loadable with loadKit. Default, Bold and Designer derive from NICHE_SPECS through their existing builders; Midnight, Network, Temple and Wildheart lay the same words out in their own blocks (lib/sites/kits/profile-variants.ts). The six-door KIT_INDEX is untouched, so each theme's own pinned tests still hold. The /themes index and every kit page count and list all 13 kits per theme. A kit is Home, the profile's main page and About; richer per-theme pages are a follow-up. Waitlist, inquiry, dues and directory are not switchable tools yet (SYS-18), so those kits say them in words.

verify.evidence: lib/sites/kits/profile-kits.test.tsx loads, applies and renders all 49.
verify.cmd: node -e 'const f=require("fs");const r=(p)=>f.readFileSync(p,"utf8");if(!r("lib/sites/kits/registry.ts").includes("PROFILE_KIT_INDEX")){console.error("profile kit index is gone");process.exit(1)};if(!f.existsSync("lib/sites/kits/profile-variants.ts")){console.error("profile-variants.ts is gone");process.exit(1)}'
